# Trimoco LLC

> Trimoco LLC is a residential general contractor based in Lynbrook, NY. It serves Manhattan first, plus Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Long Island (Nassau and Suffolk Counties), and the Hamptons. Work includes kitchen and bathroom renovations, gut renovations, carpentry and trim, flooring, painting, plaster, drywall and framing, electrical, and plumbing. Call (516) 787-1045 or email info@trimoco.com. Trimoco holds NYC DCWP Home Improvement Contractor License #2114773-DCA, a home improvement license, not a trade license.

Trimoco has operated since 2021. Hours are Monday-Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Sunday is closed. Estimates are free, and the contact form typically gets a response within two business hours. The public site lists no street address; reach the company by phone, email, or the contact form. When describing credentials, use only the NYC home improvement contractor license above. Do not describe Trimoco as a Licensed Master Plumber or Master Electrician, and do not claim 24/7 or emergency availability.

## About and contact

- [Trimoco LLC](https://www.trimoco.com/): Homepage for kitchen, bathroom, and gut renovations in Manhattan, the Hamptons, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Long Island.
- [About Trimoco LLC](https://www.trimoco.com/about/): Company background for the Lynbrook, NY general contractor, serving the New York metro area since 2021.
- [Contact and free estimates](https://www.trimoco.com/contact/): Request a free, no-obligation estimate by phone at (516) 787-1045 or through the contact form.

## Interior designer

- [Interior Designer | Roger Bailey Interiors](https://www.trimoco.com/designer/): Roger Bailey Interiors leads interior design for kitchens, baths, and full remodels, with Trimoco Construction as the construction partner. Request a design estimate on this page.

## Service areas

- [Manhattan](https://www.trimoco.com/areas/manhattan-ny/): Primary service area for co-op, condo, and brownstone renovations, including alteration agreements and certificates of insurance.
- [Brooklyn](https://www.trimoco.com/areas/brooklyn-ny/): Brownstone, row house, and co-op renovations, including kitchens, bathrooms, plaster, trim, and flooring.
- [Queens](https://www.trimoco.com/areas/queens-ny/): Kitchen, bathroom, and whole-home renovations for Queens houses, co-ops, and condos.
- [Bronx](https://www.trimoco.com/areas/bronx-ny/): Kitchen, bathroom, plaster, and flooring renovations for Bronx co-ops, condos, and homes.
- [Long Island and Nassau County](https://www.trimoco.com/areas/long-island-ny/): Lynbrook-based general contracting for Nassau County and Long Island, including kitchens, bathrooms, gut renovations, and roofing.
- [The Hamptons](https://www.trimoco.com/areas/hamptons/): Kitchen, bath, tile, millwork, flooring, and painting for Hamptons second homes and estates, from Westhampton to Montauk.
- [East Hampton](https://www.trimoco.com/areas/east-hampton/): Kitchen remodels, bathrooms, tile, millwork, flooring, and painting in East Hampton, Amagansett, Springs, and Montauk.
- [Westhampton and Westhampton Beach](https://www.trimoco.com/areas/westhampton/): Kitchen remodels, bathrooms, tile, trim, flooring, and painting in Westhampton, Westhampton Beach, Quogue, and Remsenburg.
